facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Benin has connected its national identity system through Smart Africa's SADX and is moving to a pilot letting Benin and Rwanda verify each other's national ID cards for air travel; no test date is set.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Ghana has connected its national identity system through Smart Africa's SADX and is moving to a pilot of cross-border national ID card verification at land crossings with Benin; no test date is set.
